title: Subspecialty Programme (Sp2) in Internal Medicine - Haematology and Medical Oncology
inst: Faculty of Medicine, Public Health and Nursing, Universitas Gadjah Mada (FK-KMK UGM)
Department: Internal Medicine (Program Studi Subspesialis Penyakit Dalam)
Start: January 2027 intake (new-student lecture 16 December 2026); FK-KMK UGM runs January and July admission periods
Deadline: January 2027 intake: online registration 14-27 September 2026 via admissions.ugm.ac.id; documents emailed to the programme 12-23 October 2026; tests 24-30 October 2026; results 4 December 2026
Eligibility: Indonesian specialist (Sp1) in internal medicine (Sp.PD); specialist transcript GPA >= 3.00 (programme accredited A/B); English test AcEPT >= 209 or TOEP PLTI >= 45/450; aptitude test PAPs UGM or TPDA PLTI >= 500; recommendation letter or competence certificate from the relevant collegium; valid STR; certificate of completion of the specialist deployment programme (formerly WKDS) or at least 1 year of clinical service; 2 confidential online references. Mandatory recommendation letter from the Internal Medicine Committee/Collegium (Kolegium Ilmu Penyakit Dalam). Maximum age 45 at start (older applicants need a special recommendation from a hospital director).
International applicants: Not stated on official page (requirements are framed around Indonesian STR, Indonesian collegium recommendation and Indonesian specialist deployment)
Application method: Online registration at admissions.ugm.ac.id, then email the selection documents (PDF with printed online registration proof) to the programme (ppdpdsugm@gmail.com; secretariat (0274) 553119); academic test, MMPI, health test and programme interview
Funding: Not stated on official page (scholarship letter if any; partnership/sponsored candidates attach a sending letter and the sponsor's commitment to pay fees)
Licence requirement: Valid Indonesian STR (Surat Tanda Registrasi) required
Summary: FK-KMK UGM's internal medicine subspecialist (Sp2) programme offers a 6-semester haematology and medical oncology track for internal medicine specialists, admitted through the faculty's January/July PPDS selection.

title: Subspecialty Programme (Sp2) in Obstetrics and Gynaecology - Maternal-Fetal Medicine
inst: Faculty of Medicine, Public Health and Nursing, Universitas Gadjah Mada (FK-KMK UGM)
Department: Obstetrics and Gynaecology (Program Studi Dokter Subspesialis Obstetri dan Ginekologi)

Eligibility: Indonesian specialist (Sp1) in obstetrics and gynaecology (Sp.OG); specialist transcript GPA >= 3.00 (programme accredited A/B); English test AcEPT >= 209 or TOEP PLTI >= 45/450; aptitude test PAPs UGM or TPDA PLTI >= 500; recommendation letter or competence certificate from the relevant collegium; valid STR; certificate of completion of the specialist deployment programme (formerly WKDS) or at least 1 year of clinical service; 2 confidential online references. Application method: Online registration at admissions.ugm.ac.id, then email the selection documents (PDF with printed online registration proof) to the programme (prodisubspesialisobgin.fkkmk@ugm.ac.id); academic test, MMPI, health test and programme interview
Funding: Not stated on official page (scholarship letter if any; partnership/sponsored candidates attach a sending letter and the sponsor's commitment to pay fees)
Licence requirement: Valid Indonesian STR (Surat Tanda Registrasi) required
Summary: UGM's O&G subspecialist programme trains obstetrician-gynaecologists in maternal-fetal medicine, one of four tracks (FER, fetomaternal, social O&G, gynaecologic oncology) with a departmental focus on fertility preservation.
